body:
**What breaks:** spawning `claude` by name on Windows hit the npm `.cmd` shim; that case left with the Windows code, recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`.
**How to avoid:** viola resolves the child program to an absolute path itself (`resolve_program`: a given path as given, a bare name on `PATH`) and spawns that; its one refusal is `ProgramNotFound`.
**References:** brief §4.1; security §Input Validation (child executable resolution).

- `Client::notify(method, params)` sends an id-less frame (stamps `v`/`sender`/`conn`, logs `channel-request` with no `corr`); `Client::connect_by(endpoint, process, busy_until)` takes a busy deadline (`connect` = `connect_by(…, busy_deadline(now))`, 2 s). The wrapper serves `hook.event` (re-validated, appended with `source:"hook"`), `hook.dialog`, `send`, `wait`, `last`, `answer`, `pause`, `release`, `link` (→ `{since, already_linked}`) and `unlink` (→ `{}`), the last two sent to the driven instance's wrapper.

- Moving `portable-pty` off `=0.8.1` to a release whose graph drops `pin-utils` (RUSTSEC-2026-0441) is owed, owner: "Version done-check"; the swap trigger is portable-pty-psmux 0.9.7 if the O1 stray-spaces artifact reproduces only under `viola run`.
- Keep the input writer until the child exits (the pump holds it for its life).

- The pure `statusline` module (as landed; chrono for it, no file, clock or environment read): `reading` (the payload's `rate_limits` into a `BudgetReading`; `resets_at` as epoch seconds or RFC 3339), `user_command` (a `statusLine` of type `command`, non-empty, no NUL), `override_document` and `shell_argv` (`/bin/sh -c`, `shell_argv` the fixed three-element argv `[&str; 3]`), `SETTINGS_FLAG`, `USER_SETTINGS`, `BIN_SH`, `SHELL_FLAG` and `probe_document` (the document behind Run B's probe `--settings`, `typed/statusline.json`). Its three CLI shapes are the ledger rows `statusline-override` · `statusline-shell` · `statusline-rate-limits` (since chunk 2026-10-13-owed-ledger-rows), relied on every build (`LedgerRow::relied()` holds all twenty-four rows; architecture, Capability ledger).

| Wrapper IPC | interprocess 2.4.4 `local_socket` (sync API; the Tokio flavour, `interprocess/tokio`, only in `viola-channel`'s feature-gated `tokio_client::TokioClient`, used by `viola-mcp` alone); libc gives the uid for the per-user socket dir and the socket is chmod 0600 after the bind; the directory itself is read by `viola_state::strict::check_endpoint_dir` (the recorded endpoint's parent, through `check_socket_dir`, one std `symlink_metadata`) before a bind (`viola run`, `revive`'s start) and before each client's connect (the CLI frame verbs, `hook`, MCP's `frame`), a symlink, a non-directory, another owner or a group or other bit refused and never chmodded, an absent path passing | One endpoint per `viola run`: a Unix domain socket |

| Hook latency | hyperfine `max` < 1.0 s (SessionEnd; spine provisional) — logger init = 1 open + appends, after the hook's instance strict-modes check and `check_diagnostics`' metadata reads, all inside the gate (the timed instance must pass that check, else the gate passes vacuously); the socket-directory check, the peer-euid decision and the server check (the connected endpoint's peer pid and its OS start time against the one `snapshot.json` read) on the hook `connect` sit in that timed path too | the `perf` job: `run --perf` with `VIOLA_NAME` / `VIOLA_DIR` set, `gate --require perf` over five `perf-<hook>.json` rows (`pre-tool-use` included, on an unstamped perf session) |

| Performance budget | hook `max` < `viola_core::SPINE_DEADLINE` (1.0 s), the constant `gate.rs` `perf()` imports (SessionEnd and the spine hooks; the hook's own connect deadline is the provisional 750 ms `CONNECT_DEADLINE`, asserted below it) | hyperfine 1.20.0 `-N --warmup 3 --runs 30` via `run --perf` (five rows, `pre-tool-use` included, on an unstamped perf session), gated on `max` by `gate --require perf` in the `perf` job; the fail-open matrix also asserts `< 1.0 s` per case |

| Code quality | rustfmt, clippy (`-D warnings`, with the workspace `print_stdout` / `print_stderr` / `dbg_macro` bans and `clippy.toml` `disallowed-macros` on the tracing level macros), `cargo check`; ripgrep 15.2.0 (PCRE2; the obs G1/G3 gate tool, installed by `scripts/install-ripgrep.sh`); `jq` (runner-provided: G2's `scripts/g2-zero-panics.sh`, `scripts/release-check.sh` and `scripts/orphans-check.sh`, which refuse with `tool-missing: jq`); hyperfine 1.20.0 (the perf rows' timing runner behind `run --perf`, `-N --warmup 3 --runs 30`; `cargo install --locked` in the CI `perf` job and on the dev host, no lockfile resolves it, as measured on the Windows dev host at chunk 2026-09-28-hook-perf-gate `evidence/hyperfine-host.md`); jsonschema 0.57.0 (test harness `schema-check`, G4); syn `=2.0.119` (`default-features = false`; features `full`, `parsing`, `printing`, `visit`) and proc-macro2 `=1.0.107` (feature `span-locations`), direct dependencies of the test-only `viola-e2e` alone (the `#[cfg]` reader behind `run --mutants`' host exclusion, `harness::run::mutants::host`; no product crate depends on either); cargo-deny 0.20.2 (advisories, licences, sources, bans: C crates, telemetry crates, feature bans; the tokio ban via `deny-sync.toml` per sync crate); zizmor 1.30.1 (GitHub workflow linter); cargo-modules 0.27.0 (`cargo install --locked` in the `lint` job; the orphans gate per lib/bin target in CI, the dependency-graph review on demand); cargo-llvm-cov 0.9.1 with the rustup component `llvm-tools-preview` (the coverage runner behind `run --coverage`; `viola-harness gate` enforces the coverage floors); cargo-fuzz 0.13.2 (CI-only, `cargo install --locked` in the fuzz jobs), whose `fuzz/` workspace pins libfuzzer-sys `=0.4.13` and arbitrary `=1.4.2` in its own lockfile, outside the root `cargo deny` graph (a test-only exemption, see Build system) | Lint, typecheck, dependency policy, workflow lint, boundary review, coverage, fuzzing |

- Steps in order: `cargo build --workspace --features viola/fake-agent` with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/harness` (the CLI's `<bin dir>` is `target/harness/debug`) → a not-yet-existing home under `target/e2e-home/viola-session-*/home` (the base first prepared by `Workspace::ensure_e2e_home`: a plain directory is created; a link, as on the Linux dev host, must point at an absolute, real, owner-only directory, made again 0700 when it is gone, and refused when its filesystem reads less than the 9 GiB headroom floor free (`statvfs`), else `build-failed`) → copy the fake agent to `target/agent-run/<session>/bin/claude` on a harness-scoped `PATH` (per child via `Command::env`) → `viola verify --home` against it with `--screens --turn-stop --trusted-root <workspace root> --dialogs --framing` (print probe + all five interactive runs, Run B with its five added pastes (the long, tag-like and newline texts, then `/compact`, then `/clear`), its one `claude agents --json` read and, on Unix, its one probe `--settings`, and Run E, the `--resume` start of Run B's first session; every relied row, `LedgerRow::relied()`: all twenty-four) unless `--unstamped` → under `--statusline-echo` (clap-conflicts with `--unstamped`) `<home>/statusline-source.json` planted at 0600 with the command `<bin dir>/viola-fake-agent statusline-echo <home>/fake/statusline.marker` (no env var, no `budget.json`) → the `--agents-mode recorded|oversize|malformed` value (default `recorded`; a stale file removed before verify) written to the `agents-mode` file beside `bin/claude`, after verify because Run B reads `claude agents --json` through that copy, and recorded as `agents_mode` in `session.json` and `supervise.json` → `viola-harness supervise` as an ordinary child (outlives `boot`, stops only via `stop.request`; it hands the fake agent `--screens --trusted-root <cwd>`) owning one portable-pty outer PTY per instance via `viola-pty` (master writer kept until the child exits, one drain thread per master).
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/harness cargo build --workspace --features viola/fake-agent` — harness build (boot step 1; its own target dir)

- Unix socket: a verified 0700 per-user dir (`$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola/`, and `/tmp/viola-<uid>/` only as a fallback), never `/tmp` root, never abstract namespace, the socket chmod 0600 after the bind as a secondary control only (never `ListenerOptionsExt::mode`), `peer_creds` euid on both sides (the wrapper drops a refused peer in `accept_loop` before any frame; a client refuses a peer whose euid cannot be read), `try_overwrite` off. The directory check (`check_socket_dir`, and `check_endpoint_dir` on a recorded endpoint's parent: owner == `geteuid()`, `mode & 0o077 == 0`, not a symlink, never a chmod) runs before the bind and before any client connect, at the seams and never inside `viola_channel::Client::connect`; `run` and the start of `revive` refuse before any snapshot, child or `Server::bind`, a failed create and a refused check alike: exit 1, `socket-dir-refused`, one `process-exit`.
- `.andromeda/test-plan.md` §9 CI Integration — the jobs, the gates and the uploads
- **Home / strict-modes / creation:** `crates/viola-state/src/`

- 2026-10-03: Import an item used only inside `#[cfg(windows)]` (or `#[cfg(unix)]`) test code inside that cfg'd item, never in the file's top-level `use`: elsewhere it is an unused import that fails `-D warnings` on the other OS's CI lint, and a host's own clippy sees only the other-OS half of it — on the Linux dev host a `cfg(windows)`-only item's unused import shows locally, a `cfg(unix)`-only one only on the `windows-2025` CI lint. [corrected 2026-10-04: pre-push's WSL clone is retired and the dev host is Linux] Extended 2026-10-10: a helper function called only by `cfg(unix)` cases is dead code on Windows and fails that lint the same way, so gate it like its callers; the dev host can lint the Windows target itself, check only, with `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features fake-agent --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- -D warnings` under `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/wincheck` (it runs no test). [corrected 2026-11-06: no Windows or macOS target, CI leg or `windows-mutants.yml` remains — Linux-only since chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci, the code recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`: this entry is history, not a step]

- 2026-10-31: A case that runs on every OS must not call a helper gated off one of them: only that OS's CI fails, on a compile error in its own lint and test jobs. Before a chunk's first push whose test files move a `cfg` gate, run the macOS check-only clippy recipe (test-plan §9) as well as the Windows one, since a block entry covers only Windows. [corrected 2026-11-06: no Windows or macOS target, CI leg or `windows-mutants.yml` remains — Linux-only since chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci, the code recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`: this entry is history, not a step]

- 2026-11-06: A sweep for a `cfg` predicate reads the predicate's parse, never a line grep: `#[cfg_attr(` split over lines (`#[cfg_attr(\n not(target_os = "macos"), case::…)]`) escapes `git grep -nE 'cfg!?\(.*…'`. The census `tests/contract_os_gated_tests.rs` parses its gates and caught such a pair in `tests/hook_fail_open.rs` that the line grep read clean.

- 2026-10-04: Reading a `windows-mutants` dispatch while it runs: `gh run view --job <id> --log` refuses until EVERY job of the run has finished, so a finished job's log reads through `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/actions/jobs/<id>/logs --allow-escape-sequences` (without the flag it refuses the ANSI output), with the escapes stripped before grepping. Each job's harness document is its `{"v":1,"cmd":"run",…}` line, and the outcome lines carry every mutant's grade: read a MISSED line's cfg from source before calling it a survivor. [corrected 2026-11-06: no Windows or macOS target, CI leg or `windows-mutants.yml` remains — Linux-only since chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci, the code recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`: this entry is history, not a step]

- 2026-10-04: A dispatched run joins its sha's checks: `ci.py conclusion --sha <sha>` after a `windows-mutants` dispatch reads the dispatch's six `mutants (…)` checks too (15 → 21 on the measured commit), so the push's CI verdict is read before the dispatch, and the dispatch's own verdict row with `--name mutants`. [corrected 2026-10-10: nine `mutants (…)` checks since the root package was split by file, 15 → 24 as read on the dispatch of that day] [corrected 2026-10-13: ten `mutants (…)` checks since `viola-cmd-verify-stop` joined the matrix; no dispatch has read the new total] [corrected 2026-11-06: no Windows or macOS target, CI leg or `windows-mutants.yml` remains — Linux-only since chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci, the code recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`: this entry is history, not a step]

- 2026-10-10: In the operator pass, read the Windows-target lint on the host before the push (the command is in `testing.md`, the 2026-10-03 entry): a fault only that target's lint sees is otherwise first met as a red `lint` job on `windows-2025`. [corrected 2026-11-06: no Windows or macOS target, CI leg or `windows-mutants.yml` remains — Linux-only since chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci, the code recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`: this entry is history, not a step]

- 2026-09-25: On the Windows host, a diff that carries `#[cfg(unix)]` bodies cannot pass plain `run --mutants` (those bodies are compiled out, so their mutants grade missed), and neither can a shared body whose only killing test is OS-gated (a SIGSTOP stale-wrapper test, a `.cmd` child): read such misses as host-excluded — the epoch-boundary code audit classifies them itself. [corrected 2026-09-28: `--leg` and the CI union are retired; mutation runs at the code audit] [corrected 2026-11-06: no Windows or macOS target, CI leg or `windows-mutants.yml` remains — Linux-only since chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci, the code recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`: this entry is history, not a step]

- 2026-10-10: Forecast a `windows-mutants` job's wall from its count of viable mutants, never from its file's size: in the root package each graded mutant costs about one whole pass of the root tests on `windows-2025` (about 100 s), and a host-excluded mutant is still built and tested before the harness leaves it out. [corrected 2026-11-06: no Windows or macOS target, CI leg or `windows-mutants.yml` remains — Linux-only since chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci, the code recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`: this entry is history, not a step]

title: 2026-11-06 — End a retirement cascade with a bare-token census over every master

data.head: ## 2026-11-06 — End a retirement cascade with a bare-token census over every master

body:
A cascade sweep keyed on a retired mechanism's names (its symbols, files, jobs and closed words) misses the qualifier forms that
carried it: «per-OS `perf` job», «the per-OS floors», `[.exe]`, a present-tense reason clause («because … on Windows»). At the
Linux-only wrap (chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci) 551 patterns left 19 stale sites in 17 facts and 8 leaf lines that a
second pass found: one `rec.py find --regex '\b(Windows|macOS|windows|macos)\b'` per master (116 hits over 61 facts) plus
`--text 'per-OS'`, each hit read at its fact and ruled history, a different subject or stale. Run that census after the
leaves and before the entries close; a hit kept needs its one-word reason in the dispositions.

body:
The session made viola Linux-only by founder ruling: the OS target Windows first, macOS and Linux is retired for Linux only (core on any current distribution, CI on ubuntu-latest, the 0.2.0 window features on Hyprland), the Windows and macOS code recoverable at the pushed tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3).
It removed every Windows and macOS code arm, test, fixture and CI job: the ConPTY sideload (src/conpty.rs, viola-pty sideload, vendor/conpty, conpty_sideload test), the Windows named-pipe endpoint and SQOS/SDDL controls, the macOS $TMPDIR socket dir and macOS no-peer-pid carve-out, the .cmd/.bat refusal batch-script-child, the Windows registry env reader, the Windows VT enable (rung 7) and depth branch, the console-control stop arm, the CASE_INSENSITIVE fold, the Windows relied set of twenty-one, and the windows-sys dependency.
CI: the windows-2025 and macos-latest legs, windows-mutants.yml, scripts/junit-os-sets.py, the junit-os artifacts, the pwsh shim steps and scripts/agent-run.ps1 are gone; ci.yml jobs keep strategy.matrix.os with the single leg ubuntu-latest; workflows 3 to 2 (ci.yml, nightly.yml unchanged).
Counts moved: revive --json refusal codes 11 to 10, verify refusal codes 6 to 5, process-exit detail enum 20 to 19, diag-line os enum 3 words to linux alone, pty_backend always openpty, deny targets 3 triples to 1, nextest kill-line binaries 27 to 26.
Measured: coverage 3383 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; the a11y tui boundary and P6 cases run inside coverage on ubuntu-latest, none skipped; Linux human output byte-identical (rungs 1 to 6, stale-row witness, HELP, CAPTION).
A RUSTSEC-2026-0441 CARRY on Version done-check will measure moving portable-pty off =0.8.1; the pin itself stays =0.8.1 now.

The OS target: every claim naming three OSes, all three OS legs, Windows, macOS and Linux, or a per-OS leg is stale; viola is Linux only, CI on ubuntu-latest alone. This reaches the §1 CI integration line, the §4 cli tool-reach row, the P4 and P6 path scenarios, the §8 error-recovery verification, the §9 platform matrix and pipeline integration, and the §10 Standard+ invariant.

The §9 CI matrix [windows-2025, macos-latest, ubuntu-latest] is now [ubuntu-latest]; the per-OS test job is one leg (jobs keep their matrix.os form), so each leg's own gate verdict is a single verdict; ci.yml and nightly.yml are the only workflows.

The manual screen-reader pass: NVDA with Windows Terminal or conhost and VoiceOver with Terminal.app are retired with their OSes; Orca with GNOME Terminal is the remaining Linux target. This reaches the §1 screen-reader test pattern, the screen-reader-priority trigger assertion (NVDA / VoiceOver / Orca), the §4 supplemental-manual column (cli and tui rows) and the §7 per-surface SR table (cli Windows / macOS / Linux row, tui Windows NVDA row).

The harness runner: scripts/agent-run.ps1 is deleted, scripts/agent-run.sh run is the harness alone; the §1 CI integration runner clause (or .ps1) and the §11 CI anti-pattern glob scripts/agent-run.* run name a removed shim pair.

The §1 tui passthrough entity: the clause no viola literal on every OS, the child's own bytes on Unix, its Windows byte reading owed to Windows-only live measurements is stale; that route entry is retired and the Windows reading left with the ConPTY code, so the panic boundary is a Linux statement.

P4 wheel: the Windows win32-input-mode fact (an injected mouse report arriving as typed keys takes the wheel, F-W3, on windows-2025) is retired with the ConPTY; this reaches the P4 required focus order, the §4 P4 scenario (mouse/resize not moving the wheel on Linux and macOS) and the §11 Keyboard anti-pattern's ConPTY clause; on Linux focus, mouse and resize sequences never move the wheel.

P6 stale dim (path-p6-stale-dim): Unix legs only, ubuntu-latest and macos-latest, the outer-PTY witness not run on windows-2025 is stale; the witness cross_list_rows_dim_a_stale_row_end_to_end_on_a_terminal is now ungated and runs on ubuntu-latest.

The §1 revive --json entity names batch-script-child among the start refusals; that refusal is retired (AgentError::BatchScriptChild gone, a given path as given, a bare name on PATH), revive's closed refusal codes 11 to 10; pinned-hash-mismatch, squatted-name and the program-not-found internal-error stand.

§8 error-recovery verification (cognitive-errors): the server-verify peer pid witness on windows-2025 and ubuntu-latest, macOS reporting no peer pid with an euid mismatch alone, and the socket-directory refusal on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest are stale; SERVER_PID_REPORTED and PEER_EUID_REPORTED are folded, the macOS carve-out retired, every such witness runs on ubuntu-latest.

Refusal counts: verify refusal codes 6 to 5 and human::refuse sites run 8 to 7, verify 6 to 5 (batch-script-child gone); any cognitive-errors entity counting refusals, refusal sites or naming the .cmd/.bat human pair (the claude CLI is a .cmd or .bat script / pass the real executable, not a .cmd or .bat shim) is stale.

The socket directory: forms are now XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola/ and /tmp/viola-<uid>/; the macOS TMPDIR/viola/ form and the Windows named pipe are retired; any socket-directory refusal text or citation naming them is stale.

The tui driver: the portable-pty outer PTY now always uses openpty (pty_backend words 3 to 1); ConPTY sideload, conpty_sideload test and run.conpty_sideload step are gone; any a11y citation of a ConPTY witness is stale; portable-pty stays =0.8.1 (a CARRY may move it at Version done-check).

Visual (visual-sgr): the Windows VT enable (decision rung 7) and the Windows depth branch are retired; rungs 1 to 6 and the depth rule are unchanged, Linux output byte-identical; only an entity naming Windows VT, conhost or the Windows depth branch is touched.

§10 invariant: the epoch-boundary mutation audit lost its Windows leg (windows-mutants.yml, viola-mutants-scratch, HOST_SCRATCH, scratch_bytes); run --mutants itself stays; any a11y wording naming the Windows mutation leg is stale.

The §3 contract keys keyboard-test-harness, a11y-testing-tool-pick and ci-integration carry the OS-leg and .ps1 wording (sweep counts for a11y: os-target 19, wolm 3, bsc 3, sideload 8, os-enum 3, shim-pair 1, win-ci 16, macos-gap 3).

Indirect, through the census tests/contract_os_gated_tests.rs: a test gate naming windows or target_os macos now reads as a fault; gates whose only sibling left were made unconditional (run_refuses_a_stale_name, the hook-fail-open and handlers impostor cases, security_negatives_server_identity.rs), so any a11y test inventory listing per-OS gating of these is stale.

verify step lines: [NN/24] stands on Linux; LedgerRow::relied() is all twenty-four rows on every build (the Windows relied set of twenty-one retired); the shim-resolution row now reads claude --version answering; a P6 entity naming a Windows relied count is stale.
Any a11y wording citing the diag-line os word as windows or macos, sideload_fallback, or the process-exit detail at 20 values is stale (os is linux alone, detail 19 members).

body:
The session made viola Linux-only: all Windows and macOS code, tests, fixtures and CI jobs were removed after the pushed tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3), on the founder's rulings of 2026-11-04.
It retired the Windows named-pipe endpoint with its SDDL / SQOS controls, the macOS TMPDIR socket dir and the macOS no-peer-pid carve-out, the Windows owner/DACL strict-modes arm, the ConPTY sideload and its vendored binaries, the .cmd/.bat refusal batch-script-child, the Windows registry environment reader, the Windows VT enable and depth branch, the console-control stop arm, the CASE_INSENSITIVE R8 fold and the Windows relied set of twenty-one.
CI is now ubuntu-latest only: windows-mutants.yml, the windows-2025 and macos-latest legs, junit-os-sets.py, the pwsh shim steps and agent-run.ps1 are gone; ci.yml and nightly.yml remain.
The windows-sys dependency was removed, libc moved to plain dependencies, deny targets went to one Linux triple, and the recvmsg licence exception was dropped at this wrap.
The diag-line schema os enum now reads linux alone, sideload_fallback left process-start, and batch-script-child left the process-exit detail enum (20 to 19).
RUSTSEC-2026-0441 (pin-utils via portable-pty =0.8.1) reads red in supply-chain; a CARRY on Version done-check owns moving portable-pty off 0.8.1.

Design Philosophy and Project Intent: the cross-platform, Windows-first principle, the native cross-platform CLI, and the Scale path line about Windows, macOS and Linux CI and Windows live awaiting a Windows host are retired; the OS target is now Linux only (core on any current distribution, CI on ubuntu-latest, 0.2.0 window features on Hyprland), the Windows and macOS code recoverable at tag multi-os-final.
[Scale / Product] Personal v1, cross-platform from day one: the built-and-CI-tested on Windows, macOS and Linux claim and its retrofit rationale are stale under the Linux-only ruling.

Stack and Inherited Defaults: the binary viola / viola.exe naming, GitHub Actions on three OSes and the CI row windows-2025 / macos-latest / ubuntu-latest now read ubuntu-latest only; the windows-sys dependency is removed from the workspace pin and every cfg(windows) table; libc moved from cfg(unix) to plain dependencies in the root, viola-channel, viola-pty, viola-state and viola-e2e.

build-system / supply-chain config: deny.toml and deny-sync.toml targets went from three triples to x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu alone; deny.toml licence exceptions went from two to one (doctest-file alone, recvmsg dropped as an Windows-only dependency absent from the Linux graph); .gitattributes lost vendor/conpty/** binary.
[Concurrency / Backend Framework]: the cargo check of the sync crates on all three OSes now runs on one; the sole-root tokio ban itself stays.

[PTY]: the Windows x64 ConPTY sideload failing open to the inbox one, the System32 DLL search restriction in every viola process (restrict_dll_search), the conpty-sideload and conpty pty_backend words (now always openpty), PtyError::Load, the ReadConsoleW host_stdin reader (now std stdin), the GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo host_size arm and the TerminateProcess kill fallback are removed; the rationale 0.9.0 has a Windows garbage-read bug no longer justifies the =0.8.1 pin.

[PTY] OPEN item (key lost after resize, sideloaded ConPTY DA1 stall) and every other owner citing the working-route entry Windows-only live measurements: that entry was retired at the 2026-11-04T23-11-43-wrap; sites are re-pointed to the open residuals of origin 2026-11-04T23-11-43-wrap (target another-os) or retired with the Windows claim they owe.
[Hook Contract]: the dialog hold's Windows leg owner Windows-only live measurements is retired; the ceiling's Version done-check owner stays.

[Database / State Store] and [Snapshot writer]: the rationale that lock files are separate because append plus exclusive lock fails on Windows is a Windows claim; replace_private is now one attempt (retry_replace, REPLACE_ATTEMPTS, replace_private_retrying, replace_private_with, write_snapshot_with gone; write_snapshot calls replace_private; replace_private_shared stays); create_private_dir lost its DACL arm.

[Message Broker / IPC] and Local endpoint trust boundary: the Windows named pipe, the SQOS Identification client open and the one-API-over-named-pipes-and-Unix-sockets rationale are retired; the endpoint is a Unix socket only.

[CI/CD]: the three-OS native matrix, the Windows PATH search over PATHEXT, the .cmd/.bat child refusal (exit 1, batch-script-child) and the claude.cmd / claude.bat npm-shim resolution to claude.exe are retired; resolve_program takes a given path as given and a bare name on PATH, ProgramNotFound unchanged.

[Agent Coverage]: the npm-shim to claude.exe resolution listed among viola-agent-claude's responsibilities is gone (Search::windows, pathext, is_script, SHIM_TARGET, AgentError::BatchScriptChild removed).

[CLI Version Compatibility] and the capability ledger: the Windows relied set of twenty-one is gone (WRAPPED_HERE folded): LedgerRow::relied() is all twenty-four rows on every build; the shim-resolution row now reads only that claude --version answered (ProbeRun.program_is_script gone); the ledger scrub matches the home exactly (case-fold parameter gone).

[Error Handling] and the Rust error types convention: PtyError::Load, PinError::StrictModes, Refused::NullDacl and Refused::NoPersistentAcls are removed variants; the session measured the thiserror::Error census at 10 both before and after (grep -rn over src and crates), where the convention says nine.

[Deployment / Distribution] and Filesystem bin/: the pinned copy path viola(.exe) and the Windows x64 ConPTY companions bin/<version>-<hash>/conpty/ (pin_companions, the held-open companions, sideload_fallback strict-modes-failed / hash-mismatch) are retired; pin_bytes and the pinned copy re-hash stay.

CLI --json output contract: viola revive's closed refusal codes went from eleven to ten (batch-script-child removed); verify's refusal codes went from six to five; human::refuse sites run 8 to 7, verify 6 to 5.

Instance snapshot / server check: the clause on Linux and Windows and the macOS no-peer-pid recorded gap are retired; SERVER_PID_REPORTED and PEER_EUID_REPORTED are folded (peer_euid_admitted is observed == Some(own), an unreadable euid still refused); liveness::server_verdict and verify_server lose the peer_pid_reported parameter and the macOS Matches arm.
Hook statusline contract: the clause none on Windows for the /bin/sh -c shell-out is stale; statusline::shell_argv now returns a fixed three-element argv, not an Option.

Occupied Resources IPC endpoints: the Windows named pipe entry, the test-only SQOS pipe of tests/channel_sqos_open.rs (deleted) and the channel test endpoints as named pipes are retired; tests/security_negatives_channel.rs is deleted; the Linux / macOS socket entry is Linux only, socket dir forms XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola/ and /tmp/viola-<uid>/, the macOS TMPDIR/viola/ arm gone.

Environment variables: the R8 strip's Windows registry reader (HKCU Environment) and case-insensitive match are removed (names only, exact match); claude_env_keep is no longer a Unix-qualified pass-list; VIOLA_BIN viola(.exe) naming is stale.

Filesystem strict-modes rules: the Windows clauses (no read right granted to another SID, the write rule on Windows for diagnostics files, the read rule on Windows for events.ndjson) and the off-Unix Ok arm of check_socket_dir are gone; the Unix check body is unconditional; settings.json written only on Unix is now always.
Workspace crates test-support feature: viola-channel test_support lost canonical_sddl, dacl_of and user_sid; the JsonFields visitor stays.

Repository vendor and scripts: vendor/conpty/<version>/x64/ and scripts/conpty-vendor.sh are deleted; target/conpty-seed/ and seed_conpty are gone, so the chaos home is no longer the second carve-out beside seed_conpty; target/harness/ and target/viola-answers-*/ rationales citing Windows relink and windows-2025 drives are stale.
Repository mutation scratch: viola-mutants-scratch, HOST_SCRATCH and the harness document's scratch_bytes key are retired with windows-mutants.yml (the boundary audit's Windows leg).

CI artifacts and harness: the three junit-<os> artifacts and scripts/junit-os-sets.py are gone (one junit leg remains, job and artifact names keep the matrix.os form); the harness is scripts/agent-run.sh alone; the ConPTY vendor verification and pwsh shim steps are gone; workflows went from three to two (ci.yml, nightly.yml); zizmor concurrency-limits suppressions 3 to 2.

Repository scripts: orphans-check.sh narrows to one triple (its probes verdict unchanged); install-ripgrep.sh lost its darwin and windows arms, .zip handling and the Schannel branch; lint-probes.sh native_root is the root (MSYS fallback gone).

Cross-platform discipline and crosscut-os-gated-tests: every OS-specific branch tested on its CI runner no longer applies across OSes; the census tests/contract_os_gated_tests.rs GATES names exactly the remaining gates, and its cfg(unix) / target_os linux gate lines went from 327 in 78 files to 218 in 64.

Counts in occupied-resources and test lines: root Instant::now() + WITHIN waits went from 32 sites in 24 files to 31 in 23; the nextest ci kill line binary names went from 27 to 26 (binary(conpty_sideload) removed at .config/nextest.toml line 24).
Diag-line schema owned by obs, cited in Filesystem diagnostics: os enum now linux only, sideload_fallback property gone from process-start, process-exit detail enum 20 to 19 members.

Root bin human output and stop: the Windows VT enable (decision rung 7 and the Windows depth rows) is removed, rungs 1 to 6 and the depth rule unchanged; viola verify's stop arm is SIGINT / SIGTERM only, the console-control CTRL_C / CTRL_BREAK arm removed.

The OS target is Linux only by the founder's rulings of 2026-11-04: the core on any current distribution (CI on ubuntu-latest), the 0.2.0 window features on Hyprland; the Windows and macOS code is recoverable at tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3).

body:
The session made viola Linux only: the founder ruled the OS target Windows first, macOS and Linux retired, replaced by Linux only (the core on any current distribution, CI on ubuntu-latest, the window features of 0.2.0 on Hyprland), the Windows and macOS code recoverable at the tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3).
It removed every Windows and macOS code arm, test, fixture, CI job and the windows-sys dependency; no crate, surface or dependency was added, and Linux human output stays byte-identical (rungs 1 to 6, the stale-row witness, HELP, CAPTION).
Retired with it: the Windows VT enable (colour decision rung 7) and the Windows depth branch, the .cmd/.bat start refusal (batch-script-child and its human pair), the Windows relied set of twenty-one, the ConPTY sideload, the console-control stop arm, the Windows registry environment reader, the Windows named pipe and the macOS socket dir.
Counts moved: revive's --json refusal codes 11 to 10, verify's refusal codes 6 to 5, human::refuse sites run 8 to 7 and verify 6 to 5, the process-exit detail enum 20 to 19, the os enum to linux alone, pty_backend to openpty alone, workflows 3 to 2, the CI matrix to ubuntu-latest alone, deny targets 3 triples to 1, licence exceptions 2 to 1.
The verify shim-resolution row now checks claude --version answering alone, and LedgerRow::relied() is all twenty-four rows on every build.
The cli surface Platform line naming Windows 10/11 (Windows Terminal, conhost), macOS and Linux terminals is stale: the platform is Linux terminals only.

The cli Toolkit line on Windows VT enabling through windows-sys 0.61.2 SetConsoleMode is retired: the VT enable left src/human/style.rs and windows-sys left every manifest; the clap, IsTerminal and hand-written SGR module lines stand.
The colour decision order's rung 7, Windows VT enable failed, is retired; rungs 1 to 6 (--json, viola run, hook and mcp, NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, stdout not a terminal) are unchanged.

The depth rule's Windows branch (256-colour once VT enabling has succeeded on Windows) is retired; truecolor on COLORTERM, 256-colour on a TERM containing 256color and the 16-colour fallback stand; the style test colorterm_on_windows is renamed colorterm_without_term.
The CLI colour tokens stated at truecolor, 256-colour and 16-colour depth: any Windows depth row or vt_enable_failed row in the surface detail is stale; the token values themselves are unchanged.

Platform-Specific Notes: the conhost without VT note is retired with the Windows VT enable; the Git Bash rewritten-path warning in src/cmd/send.rs stays (it runs on Linux), so its line stands but a framing of it as a Windows-only platform is stale wording.

revive's closed --json refusal code list loses batch-script-child: ten codes (strict-modes-failed, already-live, no-session, session-live, cwd-missing, stale-heartbeat, pinned-hash-mismatch, squatted-name, socket-dir-refused, internal-error), was eleven.

The run and revive start refusal causes lose the .cmd/.bat refusal and its human pair, the claude CLI is a .cmd or .bat script / pass the real executable, not a .cmd or .bat shim; any per-cause line list, hint list or count of start causes in the surface detail moves with it.

verify's refusal codes move 6 to 5 (the BatchScriptChild arm left src/cmd/verify.rs), and human::refuse sites read run 7 and verify 5; any count of verify refusals or refusal sites in the surface detail is stale.

viola verify's relied count: the Windows relied set of twenty-one is retired; LedgerRow::relied() is all twenty-four rows on every build, so the summary's n + m and the [NN/24] step lines are twenty-four everywhere; a Windows relied count in the surface detail is stale.
The verify shim-resolution row ([01/24]) stays, but its check now reads claude --version answering alone (ProbeRun.program_is_script removed); a description of it as a script or shim check is stale.

verify's stop on Ctrl-C or TERM: the Windows console-control arm (CTRL_C_EVENT / CTRL_BREAK_EVENT) left src/cmd/verify/stop.rs; SIGINT and SIGTERM are unconditional; the stopped-run output (no step line, no summary, the fixed unable: / hint: pair, exit 1) is unchanged.

Exit-code phraseology: exit 21's six closed causes stand unchanged (pinned in tests/cross_exit_causes.rs); socket-dir-refused now covers only the Linux socket directory forms $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola/ and /tmp/viola-<uid>/, the macOS $TMPDIR/viola/ form and the Windows named pipe gone.

The diag-line schema words design-system may cite: process-start os reads linux alone (was three words), pty_backend reads openpty alone, sideload_fallback is gone, and the process-exit detail enum is 19 members (batch-script-child removed), was 20.

Typography rationale: Bahnschrift shipping with Windows because Windows is the first target, both faces being Windows-only, and D3 making macOS and Linux supported all state the retired OS target; the product is Linux only, so per-OS stack wording and the Windows-first justification are stale, the face choice itself a 0.2.0 frontend input.

Typography per-OS fallback stacks naming a face per OS (Windows, macOS, Linux) and the Linux fallback described as the widest case: indirectly stale through the Linux-only target, where the Linux render is the one render; the assertions that hold on DejaVu Sans Condensed and DejaVu Sans Mono stand.

Any design-system wording of cross-platform, Windows first, three OSes, all three OS legs, Windows, macOS and Linux, or on every OS is stale on a Linux-only product: re-worded to the Linux statement or dropped, the claim it carries kept.

Any CI reference in design-system to the windows-2025 or macos-latest legs, windows-mutants.yml, the pwsh shim steps, scripts/agent-run.ps1 or a three-OS matrix is stale: CI is ci.yml and nightly.yml on ubuntu-latest, and the shim is scripts/agent-run.sh alone.
Any mention of ConPTY, the ConPTY sideload, conpty-sideload or the vendored conpty tree as the run passthrough backend is stale: the pty backend is openpty on every build.

Test inventory cited by the design acceptance: the stale-row witness cross_list_rows_dim_a_stale_row_end_to_end_on_a_terminal is now ungated, tests/cli_verify.rs pins the 24-row literals ungated, and tests/cli_program_resolution.rs (the .cmd/.bat resolution cases) is deleted.

The run environment strip: the Windows registry reader (HKCU\Environment) and the case-insensitive match are gone; the exact strip, claude_env_keep and the eleven-name identity floor stand; a case-fold or registry statement in the surface detail is stale.

Stack traces and diagnostics: src/panic_frames.rs keeps the Unix capture as its one path with the same line shape, and the panic hook stays main's first statement; the never-print-stack-traces rule stands unchanged.

body_fields.fact: viola's OS target is Linux only (the core on any current distribution, CI on ubuntu-latest, the window features of 0.2.0 on Hyprland); the Windows and macOS code is removed and recoverable at the tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3).
A 0.2.0 frontend inherits a Linux-only target, its window features on Hyprland; the Linux font resolution is the render its typography must hold.

body_fields.change: IPC client-side server verification (anti-impersonation): before the first frame of any method, the client runs the instance's strict-modes check, a refusal writing no frame and no line, and only then verifies the server against its one snapshot read. It checks the connected peer's pid and that process's start time; a mismatch, a snapshot replayed from the log (no endpoint, pid or start time) or a check that cannot be made sends no frame, never falling back to a default connect. The client also checks the recorded endpoint's socket directory before the connect, a refusal reading `socket-dir-refused`, and past the connect admits only a peer of its own euid, an unreadable peer refused, a refusal reading `server-verify-failed`, each sending no frame. The Windows SQOS clause and the macOS carve-out are dropped.

body:
Chunk 2026-11-05-linux-only-code-and-ci made Viola Linux-only by the founder's rulings of 2026-11-04: the core runs on any current Linux distribution with CI on ubuntu-latest, and all Windows and macOS code, tests, fixtures and CI jobs are removed. That code can be recovered at the pushed tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3).
Retired: the Windows named-pipe endpoint and its SDDL, SQOS and accept_remote controls, the macOS TMPDIR socket dir and the macOS no-peer-pid carve-out, the Windows home owner/DACL strict-modes arm, the ConPTY sideload (vendored DLLs, sideload_fallback, run.conpty_sideload, pin_companions), the .cmd/.bat refusal batch-script-child, the Windows registry env reader, the case-insensitive R8 fold, the Windows VT enable, the console-control stop arm, the windows-sys TerminateProcess kill fallback and the windows-sys dependency.
schemas/diag-line.v1.json: os reads only linux, the sideload_fallback property leaves process-start, and batch-script-child leaves the process-exit detail enum, which drops from 20 to 19 members. pty_backend is always openpty.
CI: windows-mutants.yml, the windows-2025 and macos-latest legs, scripts/junit-os-sets.py, the three junit-os artifacts, the pwsh shim steps, scripts/agent-run.ps1 and the ConPTY vendor verification step are removed. ci.yml keeps matrix.os set to ubuntu-latest, and every job and artifact name keeps its matrix.os form.
Measured: human::refuse sites are run 7 and verify 5, revive codes are 10, verify codes are 5, deny targets are one triple, the recvmsg licence exception is dropped, zizmor suppressions are 2, and workflows are 2. CI run 42030025050 is green apart from supply-chain, which is red on RUSTSEC-2026-0441 alone, owned by a CARRY on Version done-check.

The OS target in every form: cross-platform, Windows first, three OSes, all three OS legs, Windows macOS and Linux, and any on-every-OS clause. The target is now Linux only, with CI on ubuntu-latest. Reword such a clause to the Linux statement or drop it, and keep the claim it carries.
The scope entity viola-pty: the windows-sys TerminateProcess fallback is gone, and the ConPTY arm behind the seam is gone, so openpty is the one OS API. PtyError::Load is removed.
The OS APIs boundary entity: ConPTY, the named pipe and TerminateProcess are gone. What remains is openpty, the Unix socket, filesystem locks and atomic rename, and sysinfo.

The viola-agent-claude entity's npm-shim resolution: Search::windows, PATHEXT, is_script and SHIM_TARGET are removed. resolve_program now takes a given path as given, or looks a bare name up on PATH, and ProgramNotFound is unchanged.

The ipc-internal channel surface: named pipe or Unix socket becomes the Unix socket only. The socket dir forms are XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola/ and /tmp/viola-<uid>/, and the macOS TMPDIR/viola/ arm is gone.
The multi-platform-exporter-compat trigger: its source names the windows-2025, macos-latest and ubuntu-latest legs, and its signal says the same sink on every OS. Only ubuntu-latest remains.

The Vector 7 trigger and any rule on the home DACL. The Windows home DACL clause is retired. The strict-modes line on a conpty companion the owner/DACL check refuses (process-start sideload_fallback strict-modes-failed) is retired with the sideload.

The run start-refusal rule in section 3 (fct-26ufyipy). The .cmd/.bat child cause and its example pair (the claude CLI is a .cmd or .bat script / pass the real executable) are retired. The human::refuse site counts move from run 8 and verify 6 to run 7 and verify 5. Revive's closed refusal codes move from 11 to 10, and verify's from 6 to 5.
The harness logs path that names scripts/agent-run.sh logs or .ps1: scripts/agent-run.ps1 is deleted, and the harness is scripts/agent-run.sh alone.

The run start scenario's ban on sideload companions' paths or hashes and its rule that a sideload outcome is never a refusal: the ConPTY sideload, run.conpty_sideload and sideload_fallback are removed. In the P3 smoke, process-start reads os linux and pty_backend openpty, with no sideload_fallback.

The wait/last scenario and the error-capture rule on MCP instance-unreachable. The Linux and Windows server-pid comparison, the Linux and macOS euid comparison and the macOS euid-only carve-out collapse to Linux. liveness::server_verdict and verify_server lose the peer_pid_reported parameter and the macOS Matches arm. The constants SERVER_PID_REPORTED and PEER_EUID_REPORTED are gone. peer_euid_admitted is observed == Some(own), and an unreadable euid is still refused.
The process-exit detail catalog: batch-script-child leaves, and the closed enum count moves from 20 to 19. This is the log-coverage fact that closes the process-exit detail at 20 values.
The process-start field catalog: the sideload_fallback property and its five words leave. The os enum moves from three words to linux only. pty_backend moves from three words to openpty only.

The PTY seam boundary wrapper's kill-fallback logging (exit_source kill-fallback): the windows-sys TerminateProcess kill fallback is removed, and child exit is still detected on the handle wait. Any rule that ties kill-fallback to TerminateProcess is stale.

The section 9 CI platform statement: the dispatch-only windows-mutants.yml (the boundary audit's Windows mutation leg) is deleted, workflows move from 3 to 2 (ci.yml and nightly.yml), and the matrix windows-2025 / macos-latest / ubuntu-latest becomes ubuntu-latest alone.

The gate-command rule that each gate is its own run step with shell bash on all three OSes. The OS conditions on the sh shim and Lint probes steps are gone, and both pwsh shim steps and the ConPTY vendor verification step are removed.

The step-4 upload set: the three per-OS junit artifacts and their cross-OS reader scripts/junit-os-sets.py are retired. The diag and harness uploads stand with their matrix.os names, still gated on the secret-scan outcome.
The section 10 build-failure condition on a diagnostics file that is not 0600 or not DACL-protected on Windows. The Windows DACL clause is retired, and the 0600 rule stands.

The mutation rule's run --mutants surface. The Windows leg windows-mutants.yml is gone, along with viola-mutants-scratch, HOST_SCRATCH and the harness document's scratch_bytes key. The surviving-mutant rule stands.

The R8 strip and E2 env fields: the Windows registry reader for HKCU Environment and the case-insensitive CASE_INSENSITIVE fold are removed. The strip matches names exactly, and claude_env_keep and the eleven-name identity floor stay.

The capability-ledger relied count. The Windows relied set of twenty-one is gone, and LedgerRow::relied() is all twenty-four rows on every build. The shim-resolution row now reads claude --version answering alone. The ledger scrub's case fold is gone, and the scrub matches the home exactly.

The cargo deny gate and any naming of its targets: deny.toml and deny-sync.toml targets move from three triples to x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu. The licence exceptions move from 2 to 1 (doctest-file alone), because recvmsg is dropped. The windows-sys dependency is removed, and libc moves to plain dependencies. The Tokio, C-crate and veil toggle bans stay.

Counts tied to CI tooling, where obs-plan cites them: zizmor concurrency-limits suppressions move from 3 to 2 over ci.yml and nightly.yml, and the nextest ci kill-line binaries move from 27 to 26, because conpty_sideload is gone.

The section 7 typed-error census. PtyError::Load, PinError::StrictModes, Refused::NullDacl, Refused::NoPersistentAcls and AgentError::BatchScriptChild leave. PinError, Refused and AgentError remain as types. The thiserror::Error derive count reads 10.

The Vector 7 and strict-modes rules over viola-state. The Windows owner/DACL arm, windows_read_verdict and the off-Unix Ok arm of check_socket_dir are removed. The socket-dir-refused detail and the NotADirectory, Symlink and Unreadable refusals are unchanged.

Any obs-plan site that points at the working-route entry Windows-only live measurements, retired at the 2026-11-04T23-11-43-wrap. Re-point it to the open residuals of origin 2026-11-04T23-11-43-wrap, target another-os, or retire it with the Windows claim.
The secret scan in CI: secret_scan.rs loses its OS arm. The scan stays green in the test and perf jobs, and its rules are unchanged.

body_fields.fact: Viola's OS target is Linux only, with the core on any current distribution and CI on ubuntu-latest. The Windows and macOS code is removed and can be recovered at the tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3).

A closed diag-line word that no build can emit leaves the schema together with its emitter, per the overseer's ruling inputs I2 of 2026-11-05. On that rule batch-script-child, sideload_fallback with its five words, and os windows and macos all left.

Gates G1 to G4 and the G2 fake-agent seam exemption: all green on Linux, with definitions unchanged.
The heartbeat liveness signal and its 5 s flip, the perf budgets, hyperfine max, and the error budget's three zero counts.
The derived-metric naming, the label cardinality discipline, the log-level mapping, the per-module Targets table and the span naming convention.

The PII data classification, veil Redact and the toggle ban, the source allow-list, sink separation, and the cookie header scrub. The cookie scrub only shares the casefold token, and its claim is true.
The send, dialog-answer, wheel and budget-governor scenarios, and the E1, E3 and E5 edge flows: no OS arm in them moved.
The Git Bash rewritten-path warning in src/cmd/send.rs stays, because it runs on Linux. portable-pty stays pinned at =0.8.1.
The section 11 anti-patterns on stdout, RUST_LOG, non_blocking, print macros and unpinned Actions: Linux behavior is unchanged.

body:
The session made viola Linux-only: the Windows and macOS code, tests, fixtures and CI jobs were removed after the pushed tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3), where they stay recoverable.
Retired: the Windows named-pipe endpoint with its SDDL, SQOS and accept_remote(false) controls, the macOS TMPDIR socket dir and its no-peer-pid carve-out, the Windows owner/DACL strict-modes arm, the ConPTY sideload and its vendored binaries, the .cmd/.bat refusal, the Windows registry environment reader, the console-control stop arm and the CASE_INSENSITIVE R8 fold.
Dependencies: windows-sys removed everywhere; libc moved to plain dependencies; no crate added or bumped; portable-pty stays =0.8.1.
CI: windows-mutants.yml deleted, so the workflows are ci.yml and nightly.yml; the matrix is [ubuntu-latest]; the ConPTY vendor verification and pwsh shim steps are gone; deny targets are x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu alone; the recvmsg licence exception was dropped at this wrap.
Measured: CI run 42030025050 green on every job except supply-chain, which is red only on RUSTSEC-2026-0441 (pin-utils via portable-pty 0.8.1 and nix 0.25.1), owned by a CARRY on Version done-check.

The OS target: every cross-platform, Windows first, three OSes or Windows, macOS and Linux statement is now stale. The target is Linux only: the core on any current distribution (CI on ubuntu-latest), the 0.2.0 window features on Hyprland, the Windows and macOS code recoverable at tag multi-os-final. An on-every-OS clause is reworded to the Linux statement and keeps the claim it carries.
The tier justification and the IPC attack-surface vector: the predictable names in the shared Windows pipe namespace are gone. The endpoint is a Unix domain socket in a per-user 0700 directory only.

The Networking and TLS rows, and every per-instance named pipes (Windows) or named pipes or Unix sockets wording, are stale. Only Unix sockets remain. The socket directory forms are $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola/ and /tmp/viola-<uid>/, and the macOS $TMPDIR/viola/ form is retired.

The CI/CD line and every windows-2025 or macos-latest leg: the ci.yml matrix is [ubuntu-latest] for test, perf, lint and release. Job and artifact names keep their matrix.os form. scripts/junit-os-sets.py and the three junit-<os> artifacts are gone.

The Auth & Authorization library row is stale. interprocess pid() no longer has a Windows GetNamedPipeServerProcessId arm or a macOS none case, and euid() no longer has a Windows none case. windows-sys 0.61.2 (GetTokenInformation, ConvertSidToStringSidW, SDDL conversion, CreateFileW with SQOS) is removed from every manifest.
The IPC access control (Windows) row is retired: the protected user and SYSTEM DACL, SDDL, first-pipe-instance, accept_remote(false) and the test-only SQOS pipe (tests/channel_sqos_open.rs deleted).

The client-side server verification rule loses its Windows SQOS arm and the macOS carve-out (no peer pid, server-verify-failed meaning an euid mismatch alone). The Linux path stands: peer pid and start time, the socket-dir check (socket-dir-refused) and the euid check (server-verify-failed). SERVER_PID_REPORTED and PEER_EUID_REPORTED are removed, peer_euid_admitted is observed == Some(own) with an unreadable euid still refused, and liveness server_verdict / verify_server lose peer_pid_reported.

The ~/.viola/ access control row and the filesystem boundary vector: the Windows inherited profile DACL, the protected user and SYSTEM DACL outside the profile, the allow-ACE read-right test, and owner and DACL as a strict-modes form are all retired. The Unix owner-and-mode check is unconditional, and the off-Unix Ok(()) arm of check_socket_dir is gone. Refused::NullDacl, Refused::NoPersistentAcls, outside_profile, windows_read_verdict and READ_RIGHTS are removed.

replace_private is now one attempt: retry_replace, REPLACE_ATTEMPTS, replace_private_retrying, replace_private_with and write_snapshot_with are gone. replace_private_shared and the mode-before-any-byte rule stay. Any text naming a retrying replace is stale.

The pinned binary: pin_companions, the held-open companions, retry_open, open_held_waiting and PinError::StrictModes are removed. pin_bytes and the pinned copy's re-hash stay. Every viola(.exe) path form, and every mention of the ConPTY companions being re-hashed, is stale.

The DLL search order and sideloaded ConPTY companions row is retired, as are the Universal ban on reaching a DLL load before restrict_dll_search and the Data Protection ban on loading a conpty companion without its re-hash. restrict_dll_search, the sideload pre-load, run.conpty_sideload, sideload_fallback, bin/<version>-<hash>/conpty/, target/conpty-seed/ and the inbox-ConPTY degrade are all removed. pty_backend() always reads openpty.

The Persistent-environment names (Windows registry) input row is retired: the HKCU\Environment reader is removed. Any R8 wording that names the persistent set or registry is stale, and the CASE_INSENSITIVE fold is gone, so the R8 strip matches names exactly. claude_env_keep and the eleven-name identity floor stay.

The child executable resolution row and the NEVER spawn a .cmd/.bat PTY child ban: the Windows .cmd/.bat refusal, the claude shim resolved to claude.exe, AgentError::BatchScriptChild, is_script, pathext and SHIM_TARGET are retired. resolve_program takes a given path as given and a bare name on PATH. ProgramNotFound and the absolute path handed to portable-pty stay.

The Statusline shell-out row (Unix only, never on Windows) is now plain Linux wording. statusline::shell_argv returns [&str; 3]. It is still /bin/sh -c with the command as one argument and still the only shell-out.

The Handle inheritance row cites the Windows CreateProcessW bInheritHandles behaviour of portable-pty and interprocess listener inheritable(false). The Windows pipe listener it covered is gone, so the row's Windows citation is stale, as is the matching NEVER CreateProcessW ban wording.
The Files at rest row: the Windows DACL clause and the ConPTY companions re-hash clause are stale. Unix 0700/0600 and the pinned viola 0700 stay.

Dependency Security: the vendored ConPTY audit row (conpty-vendor.sh --verify / --probe, Authenticode signer), the four ConPTY pins in src/conpty.rs, the committed-binary rule (.gitattributes vendor/conpty/** binary removed) and the whole dep-conpty group are retired.

The [licenses] exceptions row (fct-32d4ty7r): the 0BSD exceptions are now doctest-file alone, so it reads two 0BSD crates and recvmsg where it should not. recvmsg is interprocess's Windows-only dependency and is out of the Linux graph (CI job 127253812277 warned license-exception-not-encountered at deny.toml:26). The allow list and the per-crate admission rule stay.
The deny.toml and deny-sync.toml targets are now x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu alone (they were three triples). Any text naming the Windows or macOS triples or per-target lint lines is stale.

The CI integration header and the windows-mutants.yml row (workflow_dispatch, epoch-boundary audit, permissions) are retired with the workflow, as is the npplilir mention of the dispatch-only windows-mutants.yml --package arm. The parenthetical that windows-mutants.yml uploads nothing in the concurrency row is stale.

body:
The session made Viola Linux-only. The Windows and macOS code, tests, fixtures and CI legs were removed after the pushed tag multi-os-final (ecbe7ab3), and every gate is green on ubuntu-latest.
Retired: the Windows named pipe and its SDDL / SQOS / remote-reject controls, the macOS TMPDIR socket dir and its no-peer-pid carve-out, the Windows owner/DACL strict-modes arm, the ConPTY sideload and vendored conpty tree, the .cmd/.bat refusal (batch-script-child), the registry env reader, the CASE_INSENSITIVE R8 fold, the Windows VT enable, the console-control stop arm, windows-mutants.yml, the windows-2025 and macos-latest CI legs, scripts/junit-os-sets.py, the junit-os artifacts, scripts/agent-run.ps1, and the windows-sys dependency.
The closed words batch-script-child, sideload_fallback and os windows / macos left schemas/diag-line.v1.json. os is now linux only, the process-exit detail enum has 19 members, and pty_backend is always openpty.
Counts moved: revive refusal codes 11 to 10, verify refusal codes 6 to 5, human::refuse sites in run 8 to 7, nextest ci kill-line binaries 27 to 26, Instant::now() + WITHIN waits from 32 sites in 24 files to 31 in 23, zizmor concurrency-limits suppressions 3 to 2, workflows 3 to 2, the Windows relied set from twenty-one to none (LedgerRow::relied() is all twenty-four), deny targets 3 triples to 1, and licence exceptions 2 to 1 (recvmsg dropped).
The OS-gate census contract_os_gated_tests gained a fault class: a gate naming another OS is a fault. CI run 42030025050 is green on test, lint, msrv, perf, release and fuzz-replay. supply-chain is red only on RUSTSEC-2026-0441, which a CARRY on Version done-check owns.

The OS target. Every claim that says three OSes, three required OSes, all three CI OSes, cross-platform, Windows first, or on every OS is stale. The product is Linux only: CI runs on ubuntu-latest, and the Windows and macOS code can be recovered at the tag multi-os-final. This includes the §1 tier justification (3 required OSes, the multi-platform CI driver), the §2 unit and library-only rows, and the §9 and §10 failure conditions on any of the 3 OSes.

§1 entity viola-pty: the windows-sys TerminateProcess kill fallback, the ConPTY sideload, PtyError::Load and the ReadConsoleW host stdin reader are gone. pty_backend is always openpty. Child exit is still detected on the handle wait. The §4 viola-pty row that calls the TerminateProcess path cfg(windows) is stale.

§1 entity viola-channel, §4, §5 and §6: the Windows listener rejecting remote pipe clients, the pipe DACL denying an anonymous open, the SQOS open, the named-pipe arms and Windows handle non-inheritance are retired, along with their tests (tests/channel_sqos_open.rs and tests/security_negatives_channel.rs are deleted). The socket dir forms are now only XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola/ and /tmp/viola-<uid>/, because the macOS TMPDIR/viola/ arm is gone.

Server verification and peer euid: SERVER_PID_REPORTED and PEER_EUID_REPORTED are removed. peer_euid_admitted(observed, own) is observed == Some(own), and an unreadable euid is still refused. liveness::server_verdict / verify_server lose the peer_pid_reported parameter and the macOS Matches arm, and server_verdict_rows loses its no-pid row. Clauses that are stale: the macOS carve-out that compares no peer pid, the server-identity negatives on Linux and Windows, the connected stream's server pid on each OS, the real euid read on Linux and macOS, and the cases running on macOS too.

§1 entities viola-state and config / code-bearing state, §4 viola-state, §6, §8: the Windows owner/DACL strict-modes arm is removed, together with windows_read_verdict, Refused::NullDacl, Refused::NoPersistentAcls, outside_profile, the off-Unix arm of check_socket_dir, the Windows board_scan read-grant case, and the synthetic SDDL descriptor stubs for foreign SIDs and non-persistent-ACL volumes. So is the partially-testable reason based on the Windows DACL limitation. The §4 test name check_socket_dir_off_unix_reads_nothing names a removed arm.

viola-state fs and pin: replace_private is one attempt. retry_replace, replace_private_retrying, replace_private_with, write_snapshot_with, pin_companions, retry_open, open_held_waiting and PinError::StrictModes are gone. pin_bytes, the re-hash of the pinned copy, and replace_private_shared stay.

§1 entity viola-agent-claude and §4 npm-shim resolution: Search::windows, pathext, is_script, SHIM_TARGET and AgentError::BatchScriptChild are removed. resolve_program takes a given path as given and a bare name on PATH. The shim-resolution ledger row now reads only run.version_answered (claude --version answering). The §1 child-spawn trigger clause that says the npm-shim fixture resolves to claude.exe is a Windows claim.

R8 strip / inherited credentials entity: the Windows registry Environment reader and the CASE_INSENSITIVE fold are gone, so the strip matches names exactly. claude_env_keep and the eleven-name identity floor stay. The clause that cites the floor as measured on the Windows host needs re-wording.

Ledger scrub: the case-fold parameter is gone and the scrub matches the home exactly. The test scrub_folds_the_home_case_only_when_asked was renamed scrub_matches_the_home_case_exactly. The ledger relied set is now all twenty-four rows on every build, so the Windows relied set of twenty-one is retired.

Hook statusline: statusline::shell_argv returns [&str; 3]. The pass-through runs on every build, so clauses that limit it to Unix only, or say the Windows arm runs no command, are stale (§1 hook entity, Path 6 critical path and scenario).

Path 1 run start sequence: the fail-open ConPTY sideload step (run.conpty_sideload, sideload_fallback) and the pin_companions call are removed from the ordered start steps. The plugin/settings.json clause that says none is written on Windows is stale.

The .cmd/.bat refusal is retired: batch-script-child, AgentError::BatchScriptChild, and its human pair (the claude CLI is a .cmd or .bat script / pass the real executable). This affects the §1 child-spawn trigger (.cmd / .bat PTY child exits 1 on the windows runner), the §5 Module to PTY row (.cmd child refused), the §6 chaos suite (.cmd child refused exit 1), and the exit-cause matrix comment that names the .cmd human pair.

ConPTY sideload: retired with its tests and fixtures. tests/conpty_sideload.rs, seed_conpty in tests/support/home.rs, the companion strict-modes case with sideload_fallback strict-modes-failed (§1 filesystem trigger, §6 security negatives), the §5 setup carve-out for Windows x64 seeded homes, the DA1 answer under the sideloaded ConPTY, and the §7 seed strategy exception for seed_conpty are all gone.

§5 driver Windows DACL read-back: windows-sys, icacls grants and the canonical SDDL read-back are removed. tests/support/home.rs widen / grant_read / unwiden / still_widened lose their icacls arms, and SOCKET_ROOT_VAR reads XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.

The multi-os-compat coverage trigger and the §9 matrix: the matrix is ubuntu-latest only. The OS-branch tests named there (named pipe vs Unix socket, ConPTY vs openpty, Windows DACL vs Unix modes, macOS euid plus dir-only verification) are retired. The jobs test, perf, lint and release keep strategy.matrix.os with one leg, and every job and artifact name keeps its matrix.os form.

§9 CI platform: workflows go from 3 to 2 (ci.yml and nightly.yml). windows-mutants.yml is deleted, and with it the Windows mutation leg of the boundary audit. Clauses that are stale: the dispatch-only workflow in the Platform line, the Mutation row, and the mutants.out reasoning.

§9 CI steps: the ConPTY vendor verification step, both pwsh shim steps, the coverage job on windows-2025 after vendor verification, the dev-host Windows and macOS check-only clippy runs, and the ConPTY vendor errors build-failure condition (scripts/conpty-vendor.sh) are all gone. The sh shim steps and Lint probes lose their runner.os conditions.
§9 artifacts: scripts/junit-os-sets.py and the three junit-os artifacts are retired. Any JUnit reader that compares OS sets is stale.
§3 harness implementation: scripts/agent-run.ps1 is deleted. The harness is scripts/agent-run.sh alone, so the identical sh and ps1 shim pair with byte-identical semantics on 3 OSes is stale.

Mutation harness: scratch.rs is deleted, along with HOST_SCRATCH, the viola-mutants-scratch dir, the Windows scratch wipe, the scratch_bytes field, its TMP/TEMP/--output arm, and the scratch_bytes key of the harness document. The §2 invariant that places outcomes.json under the host mutation scratch on a Windows host is stale. mutants.rs planted any(unix, windows) was re-planted as any(unix, target_os = "none"), and the host.rs fixtures were re-planted on not(unix) and target_os = "freebsd".

Kill-line count: the nextest ci binary(...) kill line drops from 27 names to 26 (binary(conpty_sideload) is gone, .config/nextest.toml line 24). The ci-integration site over 27 binaries is stale, and so is the contracts key bootstrap-phases-derive-for-route-setup-project that lists conpty_sideload among the binaries.
Instant::now() + WITHIN waits: from 32 sites in 24 files to 31 in 23. The contracts key 5-command-implementation carries the count.

Refusal code counts: revive's closed --json refusal codes go from 11 to 10, and verify's from 6 to 5. human::refuse sites in run go from 8 to 7 and in verify from 6 to 5. Pinned in tests/cross_exit_causes.rs and the CLI tests. src/cmd/verify.rs loses the BatchScriptChild arm and the Windows relied count.

Schema conformance: diag-line.v1.json os is ["linux"], the sideload_fallback property leaves process-start, and the process-exit detail enum has 19 members. Any test-plan reading of three os words or of sideload_fallback is stale.
